end.parentNote: Reyansh practised finding how a pattern changes and expressing the rule with n. They correctly identified repeated increases and used n = 5 to find the fifth term as 10. There was a mix-up between adding a number and multiplying by n; it was corrected later when they stated “2n + 1” and “n + 3.” At home, ask them to make a short pattern and explain both the change between terms and its algebraic rule.
